response.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM per_transaction), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_anlycount, p.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall FROM per_transaction AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS avg_kept FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.above_overall, k.avg_anlycount - a.avg_kept AS above_kept, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (k.avg_anlycount - a.avg_kept) IS NULL, k.avg_anlycount - a.avg_kept DESC) AS position FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a) SELECT transref, avg_anlycount, above_overall, above_kept FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY above_kept IS NULL, above_kept DESC;
